title: POTV Lobo Enthusiast Accessories Kit
description:
Who is the “Enthusiast” Accessories Kit for?

The POTV Lobo Enthusiast Accessories Kit is for the experienced POTV Lobo user who is ready to unlock its full potential and vape like a boss. You’re familiar with the type of sessions it can produce, and you’re eager to push it to its limits.

This accessory bundle offers everything you could need to maximize your Lobo: a signature POTV tabletop Bubbler and water pipe adapter, the Gordito Mini Bubbler, a dozen dosing capsules, and more.

POTV Planet Glass Bubbler & Water Pipe Adapter

Sometimes you need serious cooling for serious hits. Attach the POTV Water Pipe Adapter to your Lobo and rip it hard through the POTV Planet Glass Bubbler to soften those lung-busting hits.

Hit it hookah-style with the included mini whip or dive in with direct draws with a removable glass mouthpiece. This large-volume bubbler holds lots of water and is paired with our Perfect Blend percolator that cools and softens each hit without stripping away herbal flavors.

Palm-sized cooling with the POTV Gordito Mini

Take ultra-cooled vapor anywhere with the POTV Gordito Mini Glass Bubbler. This chunky bubbler is designed to handle lung-busting sessions wherever you go, with more percolator holes and more water for cooling that rivals at-home bubblers.

Prep your sessions with the perfect Scoop

Pack the perfect session with The Scoop. This stainless steel scoop is designed to fill your Lobo full in a single scoop with a wide-mouth shovel for efficient loading and maximum visibility.

Plus, it has a magnetic end that can safely remove a hot dosing capsule from your Lobo! Simply attach the hot capsule to the magnetic end, remove it from the oven, and then drop it down on another magnetic surface.

A dozen dosing capsules

We’re including a dozen dosing capsules to help power an entire evening’s worth of sessions. You know the deal. Chain multiple sessions with minimal downtime and keep your vape cleaner for longer. More is better, right?

Includes three sets of POTV Lobo Dosing Capsules for twelve total.

POTV Lobo Capsule Caddy Insert

You need something to hold all of those dosing capsules, right? This Capsule Caddy Insert fits snugly inside the included tightvac container and holds up to 18 dosing capsules. Organize your stash by type, flavor profile, or by vaped/fresh with three different numbered columns. It even leaves some space for a stir tool, brush, or a boveda pack.

A set of Concentrate Pads

In case you dabble in concentrates, we’ve included two POTV Lobo Concentrate Pads so you can enjoy different blends with your Lobo. Just load the pad inside the included dosing capsule, place a small amount of concentrate onto the pad, and it’s good to go! Set the temperature to 430°F / 221°C and take long, slow sips once it vibrates.

For use with waxes and solid concentrates only. Use the included dosing capsule and only a very small amount when vaporizing concentrates. Use with liquid concentrates may ruin your device and is not covered under warranty.

An extra battery

An avid vaporist can’t be bothered with charge times when you’ve got a spare Lobo Battery at the ready. Skip the wait times altogether with a quick and easy swap. Simply unscrew the battery lid on the bottom, swap in the fresh battery, and jump right back into your session.

To keep your extra battery/batteries charged, we recommend using an external charger. If you don’t have one, they are available here.

POTV Lobo Replacement Screens and Alcohol Swabs

Keep your Lobo in prime condition with a set of Lobo Replacement Screens. These screens sit underneath the glass adapter to prevent herbs from entering the mouthpiece and will collect debris over time. Skip the deep cleanings with a quick swap and keep your Lobo performing at its best.

Use the Snaps prefilled cotton swaps to deep clean a messy Lobo oven chamber. Hold the end with the blue line up, snap it to release the alcohol to the other end, and swab away any tough residue.

Cleaning Disclaimer: DO NOT insert anything into the dimpled stem when cleaning. Clean with warm water and a mild grease-cutting dishwashing detergent such as Dawn or isopropyl alcohol.

Return policy

We do not accept used accessories returned on their own. However, your items are eligible for return through our 30-day policy if they are unused and unopened.
